# Fyntix

> Fyntix is a business growth agency connecting Search & AI Visibility with Paid Media & Content.

Services: SEO, GEO, AEO & AIO, AI search visibility, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Content strategy & creation, Growth strategy & reporting.

Contact: info@fyntix.com

248 Coronation Dr, Scarborough, ON M1E 2J4, Canada
